A COMPLETE WALKTHROUGH

Follow a promise.
Inspect its evidence.

A 111-second tour of three outcomes, using synthetic test data.

The demo shows the actual application. Narration uses a system speech voice. All included app identities and personal data are fictional; these are demonstrations of the review workflow.

Download video ↓

Read the walkthrough

Start with a broken promise: review the policy claims, then inspect two potential contradictions and one data-type disclosure match. Each finding connects a policy quote to the captured request.

Switch to a policy that discloses all three observed types. The results are disclosure matches, with the same limits on purpose, consent, and legal interpretation.

Finally, inspect a capture with an omitted request body. The tool reports insufficient evidence instead of treating missing data as a passing result.

Export a masked report containing source references and input fingerprints. Bring your own policy and HAR through the same workflow.
